title: Information Technology - Security Techniques - Evaluation Criteria of it Security, Part 3: Security Assurance Requirements
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO/IEC 15408 defines the assurance requirements of ISO/IEC 15408. It inckjdes the evaluation assurance levels (EALs) that define a scale for measuring assurance, the individual assurance components from which the assurance levels are composed, and the criteria for evaluation of PPs and STs.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
